gaps.quote: Each call on width $u$ makes $s$ calls on width $u/m$, and each level divides the volume among the $W$ roles.
gaps.note: The page states the recursive structure (s calls on width u/m per call, volume divided among W roles per level) without justification, and the leaf-volume count depends on it.
